name: RingSink

test_list.description: A full ring overwrites the oldest line; the snapshot holds the last `capacity` lines.
Each overwritten line increments dropped(); nothing counts while there is room.
Snapshots list lines oldest to newest with strictly increasing sequence numbers, also after wrap-around.
time, level, target and message come back unchanged; an untruncated line is not flagged.
Lines longer than the fixed line limit are cut at a UTF-8 boundary and flagged truncated; the slot never grows.
new(0) yields a one-slot ring instead of panicking.
8 producers x 500 pushes: len == capacity and dropped == pushes - capacity.
proptest: for any record sequence the snapshot equals the last `capacity` records in order and dropped == overflow count.

output_description: Stored in a pre-allocated slot; overwrite-oldest, never blocks on I/O, never allocates after construction.
